transcript: A mistake I made... one time we posted a promotion on Facebook with the wrong discount code. It said SAVE20 but the code in the system was SAVE15, so customers couldn't use it and they commented a lot, some were quite rude. But to be honest, it wasn't really my fault, the sales team gave me the code in a message and they changed it after without telling me. I just posted what they sent me. When people started complaining I told my manager and she asked sales to fix it, and they made SAVE20 work in the end. So it was okay. The lesson is that other teams need to communicate better with marketing, we often get information very late or it changes. I told my manager that we should have a better process between the teams. I'm not sure if they changed anything after that. For myself, I learned to always keep screenshots of what people send me, so if something goes wrong I can show where the information came from. That's important for protecting yourself at work.
